differentiators.observation: Refuse-with-clarity retention: the protected handle carries a frozen retention fact (retainable:false, exact code, prose reason, resolved store facts) instead of silently acting local-first, and the durable store provably never holds protected bytes (sentinel grep across the offline lifecycle). The frozen Firebase arm persists protected rows in the browser cache with no equivalent custody statement.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Protected rows never cold-retained without lease custody, and the refusal stays coded on the handle.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: evidence/phase-warm.json, evidence/scenario-evidence.json A1-10/A1-11 vs diaries/0027 (Firebase persistentLocalCache)

differentiators.observation: Durable offline outbox under REAL sessions custody: client-minted clientMutationId + monotonic sequence at queue time, survival across a genuine process restart, ordered exactly-once replay ({replayed:2,failed:0,remaining:0}), idempotent re-drain, and machine-checkable single-commit proof — richer settlement evidence than any frozen arm surfaced.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Queue identity minted at enqueue, sequence-ordered drain, settlement-ledger dedupe on redelivery.

differentiators.observation: Versioned-seed reset-install as cleanup: a receipted, predecessor-stream-gated reset restored the literal seed (resetDeletedRows:10) and the next dev start accepted the database — deterministic acceptance loops without hand-rolled cleanup scripts (frozen arms all hand-rolled).
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The reset receipt and the exact expectedDataVersionStream gate.

differentiators.observation: Deterministic export: byte-identical exports across reruns AND across a full reset/reseed/replay cycle (same sha256), for free from deterministic ordering + canonical projection.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Stable field ordering and server-authoritative row order feeding the export.

differentiators.observation: The whole 13-check suite — two dev-server stop/start cycles, five cold child processes, a destructive versioned reset — runs in 6.6 seconds; iteration speed was never the bottleneck.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Machine-readable dev lifecycle (ready descriptor + snapback.dev.v1 events + stdin-close stop) that makes suites own their servers.

differentiators.observation: Uniform non-disclosing denial on read AND subscribe for the outsider (same code, both paths), consistent with the A2 arm — the strongest negative-contract shape in the sweep so far.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Byte-uniform SNAPBACK_AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED on protected read and subscribe.
